facts.text: I am looking for help organizing my family recipes.
I recently found my grandmother's old handwritten recipe book while sorting out her belongings after her funeral.
I took a week off work to help my family with sorting out my grandmother's belongings after her funeral.
I want to digitize my grandmother's handwritten recipe book.
I want to share the digitized recipe book with the rest of my family.
I like the idea of creating a digital recipe book and adding stories and context to the recipes.
I am not super tech-savvy.
I want suggestions for making the digital recipe book visually appealing and easy to navigate.
I like the idea of using a consistent design theme and adding images and photos to make the digital recipe book more engaging.
I want to use a platform like Canva to design the book.
I want to export the Canva design as a PDF to share with my family.
I like the idea of using Canva to design the digital recipe book.
Before I start designing, I want to organize the recipes into categories and create an outline for the book.
I plan to organize my recipes into categories by course.
I plan to use course categories including appetizers, soups, salads, main courses, sides, desserts, and beverages.
I will consider adding a section for special occasions like holidays and family gatherings.
For the outline, I will start with a table of contents listing the main categories and sections.
I will break down each category into subcategories or chapters.
I will list the recipes under each subcategory with a brief description or note about each recipe.
I might add introduction and conclusion sections to each category.
I might include additional content like stories or tips that do not fit into a specific recipe.
I think I am ready to start designing my digital recipe book in Canva.
I want a walkthrough of creating a new design project in Canva.
I want help selecting a template in Canva that will work well for my recipe book.
